snippet.title: Deja View - A Spot The Difference Game - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
🖼️ Deja View – A Spot the Difference Game is OUT NOW on Steam! 🔍
Step into a surreal world of hand-drawn illustrations and sharpen your eyes across beautifully crafted puzzles.

🎮 Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3581940/Deja_View__A_Spot_The_Difference_Game/

✨ What to Expect:
• 16 dreamy spot-the-difference puzzles
• 20 differences per part – 640 in total!
• Intricate, surreal hand-drawn art
• Unlockable original soundtrack in the Jukebox
• Achievements
• A cozy, creative, and relaxing experience

Whether you're a puzzle lover or just here for the vibes—Deja View offers a satisfying journey of detail, calm, and curiosity.

👍 Like what you see?
Don’t forget to wishlist, review, and share to support our indie team!

📱 Follow us:
X : https://x.com/GemcraftGames
